prerequisites: Electrical circuits: Kirchhoff's voltage law, Kirchhoff's current law, Millman's theorem

learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to apply various signal processing methods, both offline and online, to enhance the measurement quality within a system.
Students will understand the link between Fourier and Laplace transforms.
Be able to calculate the Fourier transform of piecewise constant signals representing the output voltage of switching static converters.
In an electrical system containing passive dipoles or active quadripoles, determine the system transfer function and compute the Fourier transform of various output quantities.
Develop and analyze a computer code performing frequency-domain diagnostics and assess its relevance and effectiveness.

syllabus_topics: Signal processing in the time domain, linear filtering
Signal processing in the frequency domain, Fourier transform
teaching_methods: Problem based learning including reverse engineering approach
